rules.statement: A subject can sue the Crown for a declaration of title, but not in an action seeking substantial damages for wrongful possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "The proper order to make in this case is that the case be remitted to the District Court to make the necessary amendments in the pleadings arising out of the undertaking made in open 74 Court by plaintiff's counsel, withdrawing all claims in respect of tort and confining his claim to a simple one of title."
